inspecting.registration: Align beige block corners. Keep panel 5 wobble in the screw only. Enlarge eye with white/pupil kept as fixed materials. Panel 1 is an introduction; subsequent inspections can retain the glass.

executing.registration: The lever base drifts upon reaching in the raw art. Align the base/pivot and keep it fixed through the throw. If the lever arc feels fast add an intermediate shaft rotation around the pivot; shoulders follow hand. Protect the red handle as a fixed material.

researching.registration: Tripod stays planted. Register on its feet, retain notebook/pencil/paper marks and green or blue lens as fixed material. Inspect panel 1 where hand and tube contact.

coordinating.registration: Register on board frame and map pins. Leafy tree tops and red route arrow should flip together. The helper is a separate, smaller monkey; both tails belong to their corresponding figures. Avoid collapsing two characters at 1x.

parallel.registration: Freeze the bases of all three keyboards. Pose 5 offers simultaneous contact with the front floor keyboard and both upper keyboards. Hold foot-up before impact. The beige keycaps, gray stands, steel stool and skin are fixed.

compacted.registration: Key on cabinet shell at right. Allow drawer movement and paper overlap at its left. Paper pile is drawn cut-flat at left edge of its cell in initial poses; select a subset/round the exposed margin if clipping reads at 1x. Watch pile conservation. End on pose 6 before state returns.

working.registration: Anchor on the table feet and front edge. Preserve ownership of each bunch: when a bunch leaves the table its resting spot should be empty. Green/yellow banana fills and the table are fixed colors.

building.registration: Align bottom block and floor across poses. Keep hard hat and yellow blocks fixed under fur recoloring. The straight yellow blocks read as bricks; if the banana motif vanishes at 1x, add a curved banana stamp to their front faces.

transferring.registration: Keep both basket bases pinned and badge symbols legible. Allow feet to translate with the carry. Last pose faces the destination; if replaying, stage a return step before reaching into the source basket.

external.registration: Keep pulley sheave and feet fixed across all six panels. Pin the cloud at the top and keep the card linked to the bucket until retrieval. In the raw sixth pose the checked card returns to the bucket; stage that hand-off if it pops at playback. Keep white cloud, green check, beige bucket and rope fixed.
